Get used to the term "Agentic Insider" and it is NOT a term of endearment, and this one too "Guardian Agents". 

Security Boffins @ Microsoft indicate they have extended previously announced "Project Perception" to be able supervise agentic insiders in real time and make agent "containment smarter and stronger" . 

As discussed, securing agents requires protection across multiple layers: identity, permissions, data, endpoints, network, cloud and runtime ....  MS will apply principles of Zero Trust and other techniques...  https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2026/10/19/securing-the-agentic-insider/
